stable_driven.alignment: same frame and channel, no alignment or startup exemption

self_oscillation.method: First absolute threshold crossing for startup; RMS and interpolated rising-zero-crossing frequency over final half of trace. Compare each visible lane and output independently. Both traces must cross startup threshold and contain at least ten late rising crossings.
self_oscillation.justification: Autonomous nonlinear oscillation accumulates phase error from f32 rounding. Fixed threshold crossing bounds growth timing to max(2 ms,1%); final-half RMS within1%, absolute peak within2%, and mean interpolated rising-crossing frequency within0.1% constrain envelope and tuning without waveform alignment. Genuine noise and several seeds, including a small early-noise seed, remain enabled. No post-comparison tolerance changes.

acceptance.metadata: channel counts exact; unexposed Rust output padding zero; every output finite

additional_fixture_predeclaration.name: resonance_cv_extremes
additional_fixture_predeclaration.rationale: A 2 V constant audio input with drive 0 gives normalized input 0.4, allowing feedback to affect the filter rather than permanently saturating its input. The fixture remains classified as driven even if full resonance adds an autonomous component: every sample, including startup and all 257-frame boundaries, retains the original pointwise acceptance with no alignment, discard, tolerance relaxation or reclassification. Five audio lanes exercise two rounded groups and mono CV broadcast.

counterfactual_predeclaration.sensitivity: Each of the four sign combinations runs from newly constructed DSP with identical post-constructor SDK/Rust RNG seed and input. Each connected output must differ from the fresh zero-depth baseline by more than 0.001 V in at least one sample; SDK and Rust are also compared with the original driven tolerance.
counterfactual_predeclaration.zero_depth_rejection: Two separate fresh traces with depth zero and CV +1000000/-1000000 must be exactly equal to the fresh zero-CV, zero-depth baseline in every f32 output sample and initial/final RNG state, independently in SDK and Rust. No mixed-segment retained history is used for this proof.

method: Compile actual pinned VCF class prefix in temporary storage, replacing plugin.hpp only and omitting widgets. Genuine SDK random::uniform() remains intact. Seed SDK random::local() after constructing VCF, with the exact Rust algorithm and seed warmup. Assert actual SDK connected-output channel counts before adapting disconnected host output frames. Rust source is unchanged except appended test-only private RNG accessors; parameter changes rebuild production module and adopt all state. Compare every driven visible sample from frame zero. Decimal traces are parsed back to f32 before comparison; both print formats retain enough significant digits for exact f32 round-trip. Separate fixed self-oscillation metrics; no trace alignment or warmup.
limitations: No native app, GUI, audio device or speakers opened
Minimal adapters bypass Engine graph/cable delay, selected-output and tap consumers, public parameter validation, bypass and lifecycle; separate host tests qualify these
Nonfinite inputs and host finite-voltage clamp tested separately; oracle inputs are finite and host-bounded
Rust disconnected output frames are zeroed and retain audio-derived width; source disconnected storage is deliberately not exposed
Only the reported SDK/compiler/platform combination is numerically qualified
